subject: Tabletop: sanitized incident summary, telemetry extract, and SIG evidence pack
messages:
From: Audits Team <audits@securecompliance.io>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: tabletop exercise artifacts and SOC 2 SIG/CAIQ evidence

Hi Kimberly,

As part of our SOC 2 continuous monitoring for FinOptima, can you please provide the sanitized post-incident summary from your May 12 tabletop exercise, a mapping of artifacts to the SIG/CAIQ controls, and a telemetry extract covering 2026-05-12 to 2026-05-18? We need redacted materials suitable for auditor review and a secure transfer link for any raw telemetry. Target delivery: Tue 19 May EOD PDT.

If possible, include a short narrative of containment timelines and any changes to the IR runbook.

Thanks,
Audits Team
SecureCompliance
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 16:28:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: tabletop exercise artifacts and SOC 2 SIG/CAIQ evidence

Marissa / Karthik —

Forwarding auditor request below. Action items:
- Marissa: assemble a sanitized postmortem (PII redacted) and the SIG/CAIQ crosswalk. Focus on control mappings for Incident Response and Change Management. Draft by Tue 9:00am PDT.
- Karthik: produce the telemetry extract (2026-05-12 through 05-18). Anonymize user identifiers; provide checksums and a short README with extraction queries. Upload to our secure transfer portal and share the link.

I'll review once both items are in. Flag anything that needs legal review.

Thanks — Kim

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 18:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: tabletop exercise artifacts and SOC 2 SIG/CAIQ evidence

Kim —

Telemetry extract in progress. I've run the retention-safe extraction and applied hashing for user IDs; sensitive IPs were masked. ETA: upload to secure transfer by 05/19 07:30 PDT. I'll include a README with the SQL queries and a manifest (sha256 checksums).

Attachment: telemetry_extract_20260518.tar.gz (stub)

-Karthik
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: tabletop exercise artifacts and SOC 2 SIG/CAIQ evidence

Kim —

Attached is a sanitized postmortem (v1) and a SIG/CAIQ crosswalk CSV that maps artifacts to the auditor controls. I've redacted employee identifiers, removed sample request bodies, and summarized the containment timeline on page 2. Also noted one change to the IR runbook: automatic pager escalation for elevated access control events.

Attachments: tabletop_sanitized_postmortem_v1.pdf, sig_evidence_crosswalk_v1.csv

Marissa
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Audits Team <audits@securecompliance.io>, Sara Liu <sara.liu@finoptima.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Delivery: tabletop sanitized summary, SIG crosswalk, telemetry extract (secure transfer)

Hi —

Thanks for the request. We've uploaded the requested artifacts to a secure transfer and included sanitized materials for auditor review:

- tabletop_sanitized_postmortem_v1.pdf (attached)
- sig_evidence_crosswalk_v1.csv (attached)
- telemetry_extract_20260518.tar.gz (secure transfer; link below)

Secure transfer: https://redwood.enterprise/secure-transfers/FT-5931
Drive copy (redacted): https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-link/tabletop-evidence

Notes:
- Raw telemetry contains masked identifiers; full-resolution logs can be shared under a TLP:AMBER agreement via direct SFTP if needed.
- We've included a README with extraction queries and manifest (sha256) for the archived extract.

Please confirm receipt and whether the artifacts satisfy the SOC 2 evidence scope. Happy to hop on a quick call if you want a walkthrough.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Manager, Trust & Safety
Redwood Inference
From: Audits Team <audits@securecompliance.io>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Liu <sara.liu@finoptima.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Delivery: tabletop sanitized summary, SIG crosswalk, telemetry extract (secure transfer)

Kimberly —

Received, thank you. Files open and the README is helpful. One follow-up: for the telemetry extract, can you confirm the retention policy that governs the logs we received (control CCM-IDS-2 / SOC2-LogRetention)? Specifically, how long are raw audit logs retained and what triggers deletion? A short paragraph in reply will suffice.

Thanks,
Audits Team
